options.query: index=client_prod namespace=pp-samsung-dev "EmergencyAlarmServiceImpl- Validating CreateAlarmRequest" earliest=-30d@d latest=now | rex "\[(?P<alarm_id>(?:xc!)?[a-fA-F0-9\-]{36}[^\]]*)\]" | stats min(_time) as t1 by alarm_id | join alarm_id [search index=client_prod namespace=pp-samsung-dev "SuccessOnlyFeignDecoder- Successfully decoded response" "partners/users/alarm" "status=[200]" "method=[POST]" earliest=-30d@d latest=now | rex "\[(?P<alarm_id>(?:xc!)?[a-fA-F0-9\-]{36}[^\]]*)\]" | stats max(_time) as t2 by alarm_id] | eval delta_s=round(t2-t1, 3) | bin t1 span=1d as _time | stats p50(delta_s) as "P50 (s)" p95(delta_s) as "P95 (s)" p99(delta_s) as "P99 (s)" avg(delta_s) as "Avg (s)" by _time
